scope: A supplied Live domain, enabled next-event premise and strict internal rank give actual bounded nonempty first-return completion, rule out unfinished deadlock/infinite internal runs, and compose reported histories through actual boundary states under existing LocalExact and support laws. Finite repetition requires renewed admission and actual-boundary closure. Funded nonstall, refusal, paid deadlock and stalling delimit the contract; the unchanged payable predictor supplies an actual four-event application. No probability, physical clock, scheduler, free failure report or reset.
